in_hebrew.name: Ludovina
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ludovina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word "ludus", meaning 'game' or 'play'. In Christianity, Ludovina is associated with Saint Ludovica, a noblewoman who devoted her life to serving the poor. Her name signifies a strong and compassionate spirit, symbolizing the Christian virtue of charity.
